title: Golden Bites
description: A sweet and crunchy dessert made with golden sugar and butter. Perfect for a quick snack.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat.
Add the golden sugar to the melted butter and stir until combined.
Press the sugar mixture into the center of the baking sheet.
Place the bakes bites on top of the sugar mixture.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely.
